body:
Direct human correction received 2026-10-05T04:15Z: "PR410's summary reads as a development diary, comparing different stages of iteration. This is wrong. The PR summary should reflect the current state of the change relative to the base. This should be in the implementation agent guidance and should also be enforced by the QA agent."

Final-state PR communication amendment (direct human instruction, 2026-10-04 21:15 America/Los_Angeles): The PR Summary must describe the final proposed change relative to the actual target base or pinned parent, not a development diary or comparisons among implementation iterations. Explain the base-state user problem, final solution and intended observable outcome. Main Test plan and Before/After evidence must support that base-to-final behavior, not promote an intermediate fix-to-fix comparison as the PR's baseline. Keep iteration, cleanup, review chronology and operational receipts in linked comments/artifacts; retain exact historical evidence and identities without cluttering the main review narrative. Implementation must reconcile the whole final description; independent QA must reject iteration-first or wrong-baseline presentation with concrete corrections, even with green code checks. This communication correction does not authorize unrelated product changes, evidence deletion, relaxed gates, or runtime pin migration.

PR410 human-ready removed for this requested communication/evidence correction. Existing PR410 implementation owner remains sole writer; same independent QA retained. Existing canonical workflow-sync PR1 owner will update implementation guidance and QA enforcement after PR410 correction within the implementation slot. Existing runtime pins stay unchanged; this direct instruction governs immediately. PR415 source/parent unchanged; its distinct readiness is not a fresh certificate for PR410. No merge/deploy or new product scope.
